payload.explanation: The diagnostic report attributes the stuck inventory decrement to lock contention: the business request (session_372c7fa6286f) waits on a transactionid lock held by session_a8961bca7237, an idle-in-transaction session that ran the same UPDATE and is the root of the blocking chain. The state report confirms session_a8961bca7237 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session has no allowed actions and must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the business request can complete (expected stock 99); no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
